acceptedAnswer.text: Currently, Laloo provides three walking routes in Los Angeles. You can explore downtown, Hollywood Boulevard, and central Santa Monica with these guided paths.

acceptedAnswer.text: The 'Downtown merkez' route includes stops at Union Station, Olvera Street, Grand Park, and the Walt Disney Concert Hall. The route covers a distance of 2.086 km and takes approximately 26 minutes and 25 seconds to complete.

acceptedAnswer.text: The 'Santa Monica merkezi' route is the longest of the three, spanning 3.023 km. It’s estimated to take around 38 minutes and 11 seconds to walk the entire route.
